title: Gift Cards & Store Credit Terms: Issue of Instruments, Values and Dates
content:
**1. Issue channels.** A Gift Cards & Store Credit instrument is issued only through its own issue channel:

- a Marlowe Rewards Note only by the loyalty conversion run, or as a reissue on a return refund;
- a Bonus Gift Card only by the bonus promotion;
- Goodwill Credit only as delivery-claim compensation;
- Return Store Credit only by a return refund;
- a gift card (Marlowe & Finch Gift Card or Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card) only by purchase.

An agent never creates value outside these channels, and never issues an instrument as a substitute for one that is not owed.

**2. Issue value.** The issue value is the amount owed by the issuing event, rounded half up to the cent, never lower than the type's minimum issue value and never higher than the type's maximum balance.

**3. Valid-from date.** The valid-from date is the issue date plus the type's valid-from delay in calendar days.

**4. Expiry date.** The expiry date is set according to how the type's validity is based:

| Type | Expiry date |
|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note, issued by conversion | The issue date plus the Rewards Note validity days of the Marlowe Rewards tier recorded on the conversion |
| Marlowe Rewards Note, issued as a reissue | The later of the original note's expiry date, and the reissue date plus the minimum validity Marlowe Rewards sets for a reissued note |
| Bonus Gift Card and Goodwill Credit (fixed-day types) | The valid-from date plus the type's validity days |
| Return Store Credit, Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | No expiry date |

**5. Initial load and activation.** The initial load posts together with the creation of the instrument. Electronic instruments activate on their valid-from date, which for every instrument except the Bonus Gift Card is the issue date. A plastic Marlowe & Finch Gift Card activates when the order carrying it is dispatched.

**6. Gift card purchases.** A gift card purchase cannot be returned for a refund of its price.

## Clause 4 for a reissued note, worked in the abstract

| Original note's expiry date compared with the reissue date plus the reissue minimum validity | Expiry date of the reissued note |
|---|---|
| Original expiry date is later | The original note's expiry date |
| Reissue date plus the minimum validity is later | The reissue date plus the minimum validity |
| Both fall on the same day | That day |

## Activation at a glance

| Instrument | Becomes spendable |
|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card, Return Store Credit, Goodwill Credit, Marlowe Rewards Note | On the issue date |
| Bonus Gift Card | On its valid-from date, after its valid-from delay |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card (plastic) | When the order carrying it is dispatched |
